text:
Samira (CS): quick heads-up — onboarding for Clearwave Health showing increased tail latency on chat/generate (~p95 up ~350ms over last 24h). Renewal call next week; want to propose a low-risk perf play: temporary model hop to compact-llama-7B-quant + routing rule to prefer compact during normal traffic and fallback to gpu-large during bursts. also want a small eval run to check quality delta on the welcome_flow_qa set.

Ravi (Solutions): can you paste the p50/p95 numbers and a sample request? i want to estimate token-level savings and impact on accuracy.

Samira (CS): p50 ~210ms, p95 ~860ms (chat/generate, avg payload ~120 tokens). sample prompt: "user": "Summarize the patient's recent visit notes and highlight follow-ups" — small set of long-context prompts. quality checks: historically compact-llama works ~95% on our evals but we need to re-run the latest prompt set.

Maya (SRE): curious if the latency spikes align with caching misses / long KV cache warmups. any change in request distribution?

Samira (CS): noticed some spike windows around 03:15 UTC and 15:40 UTC — looks like batched onboarding traffic from integration tests. routing might help smooth.

Ravi (Solutions): agree on trial. suggested rollout plan: 1) run offline eval (welcome_flow_qa) comparing metrics: exact-match / rouge / hallucination rate; 2) canary 10% traffic to compact-llama-7B-quant with routing policy `prefer=compact, fallback=gpu-large, window=5m`; 3) monitor token-cost delta, p95, and user-feedback flags for 48h.

Samira (CS): tagging Maya for canary infra. Jordan (Customer) — FYI, we'll run a short canary tomorrow morning and monitor. want to give you a heads-up before the renewal call.

Jordan (Customer): appreciate the proactive approach. main ask: no visible regressions for clinician-facing summaries. if quality drops we should auto-roll back. can you add a feedback toggle in the UI so I can flag bad outputs during the canary?

Maya (SRE): will set up canary. adding `auto_rollback_on_quality=true` if feedback rate >2% within 30m. also will wire up latency alerts to Slack.

Ravi (Solutions): sample routing snippet for Redwood Console (pseudo-yaml):
```yaml
rules:
  - name: compact-prefer
    match: route.path == "/v1/chat"
    prefer: compact-llama-7B-quant
    fallback: gpu-large-13B
    canary_percent: 10
    window: 5m
```

Samira (CS): i'll schedule the eval run and attach results here. can someone run a small A/B quality check and collect free-text feedback from the Customer UI? we should capture examples to share with Jordan.

Maya (SRE): setting up canary job now. ETA 2 hours. deploy-bot: please create canary deployment record.

deploy-bot: Canary created (id: canary-8087654321). Observability links: https://console.redwood/example/canary/canary-8087654321

Ravi (Solutions): after the eval, if quality delta < 2% and cost savings > 20% we recommend fast follow to 50% then 100% over 72h. else we keep compact as a fallback only.

Samira (CS): noted. i'll capture renewal risk note: "proactive perf remediation queued — canary running; expected to reduce p95 and cost with minimal quality impact" and add to the renewal brief. assigning follow-ups: @Ravi run eval + A/B, @Maya run canary infra + auto-rollback, @Jordan enable feedback toggle.

Jordan (Customer): enabled feedback toggle. will ping if anything looks off. thanks for being proactive :pray:

Maya (SRE): canary metrics streaming now. initial p95 for canary group: 420ms, baseline group p95: 880ms. quality quick-check (20 samples) shows minor phrasing differences, no hallucinations.

Ravi (Solutions): great — let's keep canary at 10% for another 12h, collect more feedback and run full eval overnight. Samira, i'll post a concise slide for the renewal deck showing latency/cost delta and quality summary.

Samira (CS): perfect. closing loop: will add the eval artifact + sample flagged feedback to the renewal packet. will update thread after the 12h window. :white_check_mark:
